name: request_security_lower_tf_requested_context_capture
script:
indicator("Request Lower TF Requested Context Capture", overlay=True)
ctx_time, ctx_time_close, ctx_mult, ctx_intraday, ctx_daily = request.security_lower_tf(
    "BTCUSDT",
    "30",
    lambda ctx: (
        ctx.time,
        ctx.time_close,
        ctx.timeframe_info.multiplier,
        1 if ctx.timeframe_info.isintraday else 0,
        1 if ctx.timeframe_info.isdaily else 0,
    ),
)
ltf_time, ltf_open, ltf_high, ltf_low, ltf_close, ltf_volume = request.security_lower_tf(
    "BTCUSDT",
    "30",
    ("time", "open", "high", "low", "close", "volume"),
)
plot(ctx_time.size(), "LTF Ctx Count")
plot(ctx_time.last(), "LTF Ctx Time Last")
plot(ctx_time_close.last(), "LTF Ctx Time Close Last")
plot(ctx_time_close.last() - ctx_time.last(), "LTF Ctx Duration Last")
plot(ctx_mult.last(), "LTF Ctx Mult Last")
plot(ctx_intraday.last(), "LTF Ctx Intraday Last")
plot(ctx_daily.last(), "LTF Ctx Daily Last")
plot(ltf_time.get(0), "LTF Ctx Time 0")
plot(ltf_open.get(0), "LTF Ctx Open 0")
plot(ltf_high.get(0), "LTF Ctx High 0")
plot(ltf_low.get(0), "LTF Ctx Low 0")
plot(ltf_close.get(0), "LTF Ctx Close 0")
plot(ltf_volume.get(0), "LTF Ctx Volume 0")
plot(ltf_time.get(1), "LTF Ctx Time 1")
plot(ltf_open.get(1), "LTF Ctx Open 1")
plot(ltf_high.get(1), "LTF Ctx High 1")
plot(ltf_low.get(1), "LTF Ctx Low 1")
plot(ltf_close.get(1), "LTF Ctx Close 1")
plot(ltf_volume.get(1), "LTF Ctx Volume 1")

//@version=5
_pyne_capture_bars = 12
_pyne_capture_use_last_bars = input.bool(true, "Pyne capture: use last chart bars")
_pyne_capture_start_time = input.int(1704067200000, "Pyne capture: start time (ms)")
_pyne_capture_start_hit = time >= _pyne_capture_start_time and (na(time[1]) or time[1] < _pyne_capture_start_time)
_pyne_capture_from_time = ta.barssince(_pyne_capture_start_hit)
_pyne_capture_from_last = bar_index - (last_bar_index - _pyne_capture_bars)
_pyne_capture_index = _pyne_capture_use_last_bars ? _pyne_capture_from_last : _pyne_capture_from_time
_pyne_capture_active = _pyne_capture_index >= 0 and _pyne_capture_index < _pyne_capture_bars
_pyne_ltf_get(array<float> arr, int idx, float fallback) =>
    array.size(arr) > idx ? array.get(arr, idx) : fallback
_pyne_ltf_last(array<float> arr, float fallback) =>
    array.size(arr) > 0 ? array.get(arr, array.size(arr) - 1) : fallback

indicator("Pyne Request Capture - Lower TF Requested Context", overlay=true)
plot(_pyne_capture_active ? _pyne_capture_index : na, "Pyne Capture Index")
[_ctx_time, _ctx_time_close, _ctx_mult, _ctx_intraday, _ctx_daily] = request.security_lower_tf(syminfo.tickerid, "30", [time / 1000, time_close / 1000, timeframe.multiplier, timeframe.isintraday ? 1 : 0, timeframe.isdaily ? 1 : 0])
[_ltf_time, _ltf_open, _ltf_high, _ltf_low, _ltf_close, _ltf_volume] = request.security_lower_tf(syminfo.tickerid, "30", [time, open, high, low, close, volume])
plot(_pyne_capture_active ? array.size(_ctx_time) : na, "LTF Ctx Count")
plot(_pyne_capture_active ? _pyne_ltf_last(_ctx_time, na) : na, "LTF Ctx Time Last")
plot(_pyne_capture_active ? _pyne_ltf_last(_ctx_time_close, na) : na, "LTF Ctx Time Close Last")
plot(_pyne_capture_active ? (_pyne_ltf_last(_ctx_time_close, na) - _pyne_ltf_last(_ctx_time, na)) : na, "LTF Ctx Duration Last")
plot(_pyne_capture_active ? _pyne_ltf_last(_ctx_mult, na) : na, "LTF Ctx Mult Last")
plot(_pyne_capture_active ? _pyne_ltf_last(_ctx_intraday, na) : na, "LTF Ctx Intraday Last")
plot(_pyne_capture_active ? _pyne_ltf_last(_ctx_daily, na) : na, "LTF Ctx Daily Last")
plot(_pyne_capture_active ? _pyne_ltf_get(_ltf_time, 0, na) : na, "LTF Ctx Time 0")
plot(_pyne_capture_active ? _pyne_ltf_get(_ltf_open, 0, na) : na, "LTF Ctx Open 0")
plot(_pyne_capture_active ? _pyne_ltf_get(_ltf_high, 0, na) : na, "LTF Ctx High 0")
plot(_pyne_capture_active ? _pyne_ltf_get(_ltf_low, 0, na) : na, "LTF Ctx Low 0")
plot(_pyne_capture_active ? _pyne_ltf_get(_ltf_close, 0, na) : na, "LTF Ctx Close 0")
plot(_pyne_capture_active ? _pyne_ltf_get(_ltf_volume, 0, na) : na, "LTF Ctx Volume 0")
